title: Add scaffold-report schema and register it in doctor
description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/scaffold-report.schema.json (schema_version, project, build_type, template, generated_at, output_dir, rendered_files) and add 'scaffold-report' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES in cli/appbuilder.js so doctor verifies the schema file exists. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: scaffold-report.schema.json exists and validates a well-formed report object.
'scaffold-report' is in REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES and doctor passes with the schema present.
A test validates a sample report against the schema; full suite passes.
